headline: C&S Partners advises Mahajan Imaging on JV with Neuberg Diagnostics
sum: Mahajan Imaging Private Limited has formed strategic joint venture with Neuberg Diagnostics Private Limited for expansion of pathology, wellness and integrated diagnostic services across North India. C&S Partners advised Mahajan Imaging on…
detail: Mahajan Imaging Private Limited has formed strategic joint venture with Neuberg Diagnostics Private Limited for expansion of pathology, wellness and integrated diagnostic services across North India. C&S Partners advised Mahajan Imaging on this JV. Transaction advisory and documentation was led by H.S. ‘Bobby’ Chandhoke (Senior Partner), Saurabh Tiwari (Partner), together with Associates Arya Sharma and Aditya Singh.
